fact: The Jigiséméjiri project closed on 30 June 2023 having built a social registry (RSU) now holding data on nearly 1.2 million households, which several programs have used as a common targeting tool; mobile money payments were delivered to beneficiaries registered by the project.
title: Mali's Jigiséméjiri Project: Reflecting on the Past to Shape the Future Amid Fragility, Conflict, and Violence
